title: AnalyseRequest
description: POST /v1/ai/analyse. Text is transient: the AI service must not store or log it.

text.description: Already redacted on the phone: names, phone numbers, emails and handles replaced with [CONTACT_n], [PHONE_n], [EMAIL_n], [HANDLE_n].

context.description: Up to 10 earlier redacted messages, oldest first.

onDevice.description: The phone's own verdict. Returned unchanged (verdictSource on_device) when no cloud model judges the message.
